segments.name: Streams and royalties
segments.description: Holds stream, royalty and similar interests in precious metals mining properties operated by third parties.
segments.evidence: Triple Flag does not own, develop or mine the underlying properties on which it holds stream or royalty interests.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from its stream and royalty interests in mining properties, tied to metal production and prices.
revenueModel.evidence: are based on stream and royalty interests and are calculated on a quarterly basis by dividing all revenue from such interests for the quarter by the average gold price during such quarter.
